findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_advisor_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send the traveller's trip request to ResortFinder's travel advisors, who reply to the traveller directly with current prices and can complete the booking. Advis…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_resorts, get_resort_details, search_guest_reviews, submit_advisor_request · Private data: get_booking_link, get_advisor_quote_link · Public sink: submit_advisor_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_resorts, get_resort_details, search_guest_reviews, submit_advisor_request · Private data: get_booking_link, get_advisor_quote_link · Public sink: submit_advisor_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
